subject: Notes from our call on PMS fees
body:
Hi Rajesh,

Thank you for your time today. Summary:
- You feel the 1.75% fixed fee on the Coastline PMS is high.
- I'll send a fee-versus-return comparison against Banyan Flexi Cap by Friday.
- No change to the portfolio for now.

Regards,
Priya

source.said: Log the MoM for the Mehta call about PMS fees and email it to him.
